title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (9/20): Sky Ladder One
note_en: 正是因为……才…… is a stronger version of 因为……所以……: 正是 means "precisely," singling out this one reason, and 才 means "only then." In 正是因为提前设计了备用系统，这次意外才没有变成一场真正的灾难, English needs a cleft sentence to match: "It was precisely because a backup system had been designed in advance that the accident didn't turn into a disaster."
